verdict.rationale: The only dependent-related evidence is a published H-4 guide covering H-4 eligibility, H-4 EAD rules, and coordinating family timing with the H-1B principal. That shows Lighthouse knows the topic, but it is educational content, not a statement that dependent petitions are part of the paid service, and the pricing pages list no dependent filings. missing for 10: explicit inclusion of dependent petitions in the service or pricing, O-3 coverage for O-1 founders, dependent work authorization handling (e.g., H-4 EAD filing) as a service deliverable, independent or customer corroboration.
